from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import DoubleType
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

import nltk
from nltk.sentiment.vader import SentimentIntensityAnalyzer

# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "stnvdaanna2026"

TWEET_SILVER_PATH = (
    f"abfss://silver@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets/2026/09/14/"
)

STOCK_SILVER_PATH = (
    f"abfss://silver@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "stock/"
)

GOLD_OUTPUT_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweet_stock/"
)

MARKET_TIMEZONE = "America/New_York"

# We define the prediction information cutoff as NYSE close.
MARKET_CLOSE_HOUR = 16

tweet_df = spark.read.parquet(TWEET_SILVER_PATH)
stock_df = spark.read.parquet(STOCK_SILVER_PATH)

print("Tweet Silver rows:", tweet_df.count())
print("Stock Silver rows:", stock_df.count())

print("\nTweet schema:")
tweet_df.printSchema()

print("\nStock schema:")
stock_df.printSchema()

tweet_df.select(
    F.sum(F.col("tweet_id").isNull().cast("int")).alias("null_tweet_id"),
    F.sum(F.col("tweet_created_at").isNull().cast("int")).alias("null_tweet_time"),
    F.sum(F.col("full_text").isNull().cast("int")).alias("null_text")
).show()

stock_df.select(
    F.count("*").alias("rows"),
    F.countDistinct("Date").alias("unique_dates"),
    F.min("Date").alias("min_date"),
    F.max("Date").alias("max_date")
).show()

tweet_features = (
    tweet_df
    .withColumn(
        "tweet_timestamp_utc",
        F.to_timestamp(
            F.concat_ws(
                " ",
                F.col("tweet_created_at_date").cast("string"),
                F.col("tweet_created_at_time")
            )
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "tweet_timestamp_et",
        F.from_utc_timestamp(
            F.col("tweet_timestamp_utc"),
            MARKET_TIMEZONE
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "market_calendar_date",
        F.to_date("tweet_timestamp_et")
    )

tweet_features.select(
    "tweet_created_at",
    "tweet_timestamp_utc",
    "tweet_timestamp_et",
    "market_calendar_date"
).orderBy(
    F.col("tweet_timestamp_utc")
).show(30, truncate=False)

tweet_features = (
    tweet_features
    .withColumn(
        "clean_text",
        F.regexp_replace(
            F.col("full_text"),
            r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+",
            ""
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "clean_text",
        F.trim(
            F.regexp_replace(
                F.col("clean_text"),
                r"\s+",
                " "
            )
        )
    )

tweet_features = (
    tweet_features

    .withColumn(
        "interaction_score",
        F.coalesce(F.col("view_count"), F.lit(0)) * 0.1
        + F.coalesce(F.col("retweet_count"), F.lit(0)) * 2.0
        + F.coalesce(F.col("reply_count"), F.lit(0)) * 1.5
        + F.coalesce(F.col("quote_count"), F.lit(0)) * 1.2
        + F.coalesce(F.col("favorite_count"), F.lit(0))
    )

    .withColumn(
        "favorite_ratio",
        F.coalesce(F.col("favorite_count"), F.lit(0))
        / (
            F.coalesce(F.col("view_count"), F.lit(0))
            + 1
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "reply_ratio",
        F.coalesce(F.col("reply_count"), F.lit(0))
        / (
            F.coalesce(F.col("retweet_count"), F.lit(0))
            + 1
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_viral",
        F.col("interaction_score") > 2000
    )

tweet_features = tweet_features.withColumn(
    "account_created_date",
    F.to_date(
        F.concat_ws(
            " ",
            F.split(F.col("account_created_at"), " ").getItem(1),
            F.split(F.col("account_created_at"), " ").getItem(2),
            F.split(F.col("account_created_at"), " ").getItem(5)
        ),
        "MMM dd yyyy"
    )

tweet_features = (
    tweet_features

    .withColumn(
        "account_age_days",
        F.datediff(
            F.to_date("tweet_timestamp_et"),
            F.col("account_created_date")
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "credibility_score",
        F.when(
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("is_blue_verified"),
                F.lit(False)
            ),
            2.0
        ).otherwise(0.0)

        + F.log1p(
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("followers_count"),
                F.lit(0)
            ).cast("double")
        )

        + (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("account_age_days"),
                F.lit(0)
            ) / 365.0
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_new_account",
        F.col("account_age_days") < 365
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_influencer",
        (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("followers_count"),
                F.lit(0)
            ) > 130000
        )
        |
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("is_blue_verified"),
            F.lit(False)
        )
    )

stock_features = (
    stock_df
    .withColumn(
        "stock_date",
        F.to_date("Date")
    )
    .select(
        "stock_date",
        F.col("Open").cast("double").alias("current_open"),
        F.col("Close").cast("double").alias("current_close"),
        F.col("High").cast("double").alias("current_high"),
        F.col("Low").cast("double").alias("current_low"),
        F.col("Volume").cast("long").alias("current_volume")
    )
    .dropDuplicates(["stock_date"])

trading_window = Window.orderBy("stock_date")

stock_features = (
    stock_features

    .withColumn(
        "previous_trading_date",
        F.lag("stock_date", 1).over(trading_window)
    )

    .withColumn(
        "next_trading_date",
        F.lead("stock_date", 1).over(trading_window)
    )

    .withColumn(
        "next_available_volume",
        F.lead("current_volume", 1).over(trading_window)
    )

stock_features.select(
    "stock_date",
    "current_volume",
    "next_trading_date",
    "next_available_volume"
).orderBy(
    F.col("stock_date").desc()
).show(10)

trading_sessions = (
    stock_features

    .withColumn(
        "session_close_et",
        F.to_timestamp(
            F.concat_ws(
                " ",
                F.col("stock_date").cast("string"),
                F.lit("16:00:00")
            )
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "previous_session_close_et",
        F.to_timestamp(
            F.concat_ws(
                " ",
                F.col("previous_trading_date").cast("string"),
                F.lit("16:00:00")
            )
        )
    )

tweet_session_df = (
    tweet_features.alias("t")
    .join(
        F.broadcast(
            trading_sessions.select(
                "stock_date",
                "previous_session_close_et",
                "session_close_et"
            )
        ).alias("cal"),

        (
            F.col("t.tweet_timestamp_et")
            > F.col("cal.previous_session_close_et")
        )
        &
        (
            F.col("t.tweet_timestamp_et")
            <= F.col("cal.session_close_et")
        ),

        "inner"
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_date",
        "prediction_session_date"
    )

tweet_session_df.select(
    "tweet_id",
    "tweet_timestamp_et",
    "prediction_session_date"
).orderBy(
    "tweet_timestamp_et"
).show(50, truncate=False)

assigned_ids = (
    tweet_session_df
    .select("tweet_id")
    .distinct()
)

pending_tweets = (
    tweet_features
    .join(
        assigned_ids,
        on="tweet_id",
        how="left_anti"
    )

print(
    "Input tweets:",
    tweet_features.count()
)

print(
    "Assigned tweets:",
    tweet_session_df.count()
)

print(
    "Pending tweets:",
    pending_tweets.count()

gold_df = (
    tweet_session_df.alias("t")

    .join(
        stock_features.select(
            "stock_date",
            "current_open",
            "current_close",
            "current_high",
            "current_low",
            "current_volume",
            "next_trading_date",
            "next_available_volume"
        ).alias("s"),

        F.col("t.prediction_session_date")
        == F.col("s.stock_date"),

        "left"
    )

    .drop(F.col("s.stock_date"))

gold_df = (
    gold_df

    .withColumn(
        "day_of_week",
        F.date_format(
            F.col("prediction_session_date"),
            "EEEE"
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_weekend",
        F.dayofweek(
            F.col("prediction_session_date")
        ).isin([1, 7])
    )

gold_df = gold_df.select(

    # ========================================================
    # Keys / timestamps
    # ========================================================

    F.col("tweet_id").cast("string"),
    F.col("user_id").cast("string"),

    "tweet_created_at",
    "tweet_timestamp_utc",
    "tweet_timestamp_et",

    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",

    # ========================================================
    # Tweet
    # ========================================================

    "full_text",
    "clean_text",

    F.col("view_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("retweet_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("reply_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("quote_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("favorite_count").cast("long"),

    "sentiment_score",
    "interaction_score",
    "favorite_ratio",
    "reply_ratio",

    "is_viral",

    # ========================================================
    # User
    # ========================================================

    "is_blue_verified",
    F.col("followers_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("friends_count").cast("long"),
    F.col("media_count").cast("long"),

    "account_created_date",
    "account_age_days",
    "credibility_score",

    "is_new_account",
    "is_influencer",

    # ========================================================
    # Calendar
    # ========================================================

    "day_of_week",
    "is_weekend",

    # ========================================================
    # Current market features
    # ========================================================

    "current_open",
    "current_close",
    "current_high",
    "current_low",
    "current_volume",

    # ========================================================
    # ML label
    # ========================================================

    F.col(
        "next_available_volume"
    ).cast("long")

historical_gold_df = (
    gold_df
    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNotNull()
    )
)

unlabeled_gold_df = (
    gold_df
    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNull()
    )
)

print(
    "Historical labeled rows:",
    historical_gold_df.count()
)

print(
    "Unlabeled/live rows:",
    unlabeled_gold_df.count()

gold_df.select(
    "tweet_id",
    "tweet_timestamp_et",
    "prediction_session_date",

    "sentiment_score",
    "interaction_score",

    "current_close",
    "current_volume",

    "next_trading_date",
    "next_available_volume"
).orderBy(
    "tweet_timestamp_et"
).show(50, truncate=False)

(
    gold_df
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet(GOLD_OUTPUT_PATH)

gold_check = spark.read.parquet(
    GOLD_OUTPUT_PATH
)

print(
    "Written Gold rows:",
    gold_check.count()
)

gold_check.printSchema()

    "abfss://silver@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets/historical/"
)

hist_tweets = spark.read.parquet(historical_silver_path)

hist_tweets.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("rows"),
    F.countDistinct("tweet_id").alias("distinct_tweet_ids"),

duplicates = (
